verdict.rationale: Open processor designs, such as openly licensed RTL, do exist, so asking whether a CPU's source can be read under an open license is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the Core Ultra 9 285K's design or firmware source is published under an open license. The mentions of oneDNN, OpenVINO and oneAPI concern separate software toolkits, not this product's source, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
